title: French MotoGP
metaDescription: French MotoGP: verified dates, location and OneSliders event context for Motogp.

overview.about: The French Grand Prix is one of MotoGP's best-attended races, held on the Bugatti Circuit at Le Mans - a tight, stop-start layout that shares its site with the famous 24-hour endurance track. Enormous, passionate crowds and frequently mixed weather make it a highlight of the calendar. The 2028 race is scheduled for 8-11 May.
overview.nextEvent: The 2028 French Grand Prix is scheduled for 8-11 May at the Bugatti Circuit in Le Mans. The short, heavy-braking layout and vast French crowds make it one of the loudest weekends of the MotoGP season.
